architecture: Official Mammo-CLIP RetinaNet, B5 source layers 26/37, FPN channels 176/512/2048
tensor_padding: bottom/right to 1536x928 for FPN alignment; padded anchor centers excluded
preprocessing: Original DICOM, 5px border removal, MONOCHROME1 inversion, min-max uint8, image-only longest nonconstant breast ROI at threshold 40, resize INTER_AREA
test: Not run in this comparison; official test has already been inspected in prior experiments
precision: BF16 convolution; FP32 sigmoid and focal/regression loss
batchnorm: running statistics frozen identically; affine trainable
augmentation: shared prior protocol: horizontal flip 0.5, scale 0.9-1.1, xy translation +/-3%; image and boxes together
evaluation: common original-coordinate COCO AP/FROC, score >=0.001, NMS 0.5, max100/image; additionally report score>=0.05 COCO metrics
deviations_from_public_code: Actual high-resolution input instead of public detector loader's default resize512
Full own train/validation split instead of df.head(2254) and official test validation
Background images contribute focal classification loss instead of zero loss
Batch2 accumulation4, frozen BN statistics, BF16, balanced positive repeat16 and mild geometric augmentation
Paper alpha0.6 instead of public shell alpha0.25; common COCO evaluator instead of custom AP integration
Contiguous ROI tie handling and correct xy clipping; all original validation GT retained even outside crop
interpretation: Paired initialization comparison under a documented high-resolution RetinaNet protocol; not an exact paper reproduction or isolated architecture/resolution ablation
